label: System Flow
review:
- This video is a System Flow diagram, and the following are its intended, approved look: a near-black green-grey canvas with no texture and one flat darker shape in a corner; line icons in thin cyan boxes; dotted connectors with small arrowheads that draw themselves from one box to the next; small points of light travelling along the connectors (packets), sometimes back along the same line; every element except the active one dimmed to about a third of its brightness while a step is explained; a thin glow around the active box; the whole diagram moving and rescaling as one (the camera fitting what is visible, pushing in a little, pulling back); hard cuts to a new diagram when the subject changes; a small pill tag and a short headline near the top, its last word in cyan; outlined white captions in the lower part of the frame. Do NOT report any of these as defects, and do not suggest adding people, characters, photographs or texture: their absence is the style.
- Do report: a label or value chip overlapping another label, a box or text cut off at the frame edge, text too small to read on a phone, a diagram so crowded the active step cannot be found, a packet or highlight on a component the narration is not talking about at that moment, a stretch of more than about three seconds where nothing on screen changes, and a connector running through a label.
script:
Every beat's `visual` is a **component** brief: which components are on screen, what travels between them, and the one value worth showing (a port, a latency, `200 OK`). The video is a diagram throughout, so a role ("the user", "an attacker") is a component with an icon, never a figure.

The narration is the diagram's script. Write it as a walk through a system: name each component the moment it matters, one step per sentence, in the order things travel, and say the reply's path back when there is one. Keep each subject to about nine components; when the subject changes (from the request to the defence, say), start a new sentence, because the diagram cuts to a new board there. Name the values a viewer should see (an address, a status code, a port), since each becomes a label on the connector. Never write a beat that needs a person, a place or a photograph: this style has none.

avoid_for: topics with no structure to diagram
signals: the script names components that talk to each other
the subject is a path a request, packet or signal travels
the script walks through the steps of a pipeline
latency, throughput or a bottleneck is the point
the topic is an architecture or a protocol
